tour.test_song_kol_desc: Ride into the highlands of Song-Kol. Spend three days among open pastures, yurts, and wide mountain horizons.
tour.test_ala_archa_desc: Follow spruce-lined trails through Ala-Archa Gorge, take in mountain peaks and waterfalls, and return to Bishkek the same day.
tour.test_issyk_kul_road_desc: Explore the shores of Issyk-Kul by car, stopping for lake views and mountain scenery on a relaxed two-day trip.
tour.test_karakol_jeti_oguz_desc: A three-day trek from Karakol to the red cliffs of Jeti-Oguz, following mountain paths through the Tien Shan.
tour.test_sary_chelek_desc: Discover turquoise Sary-Chelek Lake and its forest trails on a three-day journey through Jalal-Abad Region.
tour.test_osh_city: Osh in a day: Sulaiman-Too and the bazaar
tour.test_osh_city_desc: Climb sacred Sulaiman-Too, then dive into the lively atmosphere of Osh's traditional bazaar.

tour.ala_kul_desc: Cross the high pass to a lake that changes from turquoise to deep blue with every passing cloud. Nights are spent in a warm mountain guesthouse and under a wide-open sky.
tour.song_kol_desc: Ride into the wide-open highlands where the days follow the sun and the evenings gather around a yurt. Meet nomadic families and wake to the quiet of the lake.
tour.alpine_lakes_desc: Walk an ancient shepherds' route through valleys and spruce forests, finding a new alpine lake at the end of each day's trail.
tour.jyrgalan_desc: Follow gentle trails through flower-filled meadows and remote villages, with generous pauses for tea and mountain air.
tour.alaysky_desc: Travel south to the open Alay Valley, where the Pamir peaks rise above wide grasslands and village life keeps its own easy rhythm.
tour.kel_suu_desc: Reach a turquoise lake tucked between sheer cliffs in the far reaches of Naryn. A remote, quietly spectacular journey for curious travellers.

regions.title: Eight regions, a world to explore
regions.intro: Choose a region and find a journey that takes you closer to the mountains.
region.bishkek.copy: City walks, lively bazaars, and the starting point for mountain journeys.
region.chuy.copy: Green valleys, ancient towers, and views of the Kyrgyz Ala-Too range.
region.issyk_kul.copy: Mountain trails, spruce forests, and a turquoise lake beneath the peaks.
region.naryn.copy: High-altitude pastures, nomadic traditions, and the open shores of Song-Kol.
region.talas.copy: Quiet valleys, alpine meadows, and stories of the Manas epic.
region.jalal_abad.copy: Walnut forests, hot springs, and green mountain gorges.
region.osh.copy: Southern bazaars, broad valleys, and the rugged peaks of Alay.
region.batken.copy: Apricot orchards, red rock formations, and quiet mountain roads.
about.title: About us and our guides
about.intro: We create small-group journeys across Kyrgyzstan with care for local people, nature, and the journey itself.
about.guides_copy: Our guides grew up alongside these mountains. They know the trails, traditions, and people that make each place special. This space can introduce their names, experience, and stories.
about.approach_copy: We favour small groups, locally run guesthouses, and an unhurried pace. This starter text will become a fuller account of our team and principles once the details are confirmed.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: A few quick answers to common questions from travellers.
faq.q1: How do I choose the right tour?
faq.a1: Compare the duration, dates, and difficulty shown on each tour page. If you are unsure, get in touch and we can help you choose.
faq.a2: Requirements vary by route. Check the difficulty rating and full description for your chosen tour before booking.
faq.q3: What is included in the price?
faq.a3: Each tour page lists included services and additional expenses. Please review these details before sending a request.
faq.q4: How do I reserve a place?
faq.a4: Choose a departure, enter the number of travellers, and submit the form. This is currently a demo request and no payment is taken.
faq.a5: Each tour has its own packing list. Layered clothing and comfortable footwear are useful in the mountains year-round.
faq.q6: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a6: The demo shows a request number and temporarily reserves places. Real follow-up with travellers is not connected yet.
